clue.text: Call in cop, mostly revealing white material

indicators.note: each of the three words loses its last letter, so most of each word survives

parts.note: the three words run together before each is trimmed

explanation.surface: Someone phones a policeman, and the conversation reveals some white fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' works on every word: CAL(l) + I(n) + CO(p).
explanation.definitionFit: Calico is a plain, often unbleached, white cotton cloth.

clue.text: President locks leader of movement in jail

indicators.note: locks and the leader go inside the jail

parts.note: can is slang for prison
locks are hair

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A president imprisons the head of a protest movement.
explanation.definitionFit: A chairman presides over a meeting or board, so is its president.

clue.text: Left a container in situ, for example

parts.note: a tin is a container

explanation.surface: Someone left a container exactly where it was.
explanation.definitionFit: 'In situ' is a phrase from that classical language, so it exemplifies the tongue.

clue.text: Strike — one can barely do without it

definitions.text: one can barely do without it
definitions.meaning: second meaning: British slang for clothes, without which one would be bare

explanation.walkthrough: 'barely' is a pun: without clothes you are bare.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to hit; the British noun means gear or clothing.

clue.text: Good woman's Welsh name

parts.note: a woman is a lady; the possessive gives LADY'S, apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A kindly woman has a name from Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Gladys is an anglicised form of the Welsh given name Gwladys.

clue.text: Was inclined to accept monarch as well-educated

indicators.note: the inclined word takes in the monarch

parts.note: leaned means was inclined
R is short for rex or regina, a monarch

explanation.surface: Someone was disposed to acknowledge a king as cultured.
explanation.definitionFit: A learned person is erudite, having acquired much knowledge through study.

clue.text: Reject as false record, having soundly studied it

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record

indicators.note: the phrase is taken by how it is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: read it, in the past tense, said like red it

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses a record as untrue after thoroughly studying it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soundly' looks like 'thoroughly' but signals the spoken form.
explanation.definitionFit: To discredit a claim is to cause it to be disbelieved or rejected.

clue.text: Small, dark, and naturally bright

parts.note: unlit means dark

explanation.surface: A contrast between small, dark and bright things.
explanation.definitionFit: Sunlit means lit by the sun, bright from a natural source.

clue.text: Rations for the fleet?

parts.note: fleet as an adjective means swift, so food for the swift is quick food, not naval provisions

explanation.walkthrough: 'fleet' looks like a navy, but here it is the adjective meaning quick, so the rations are quick meals.
explanation.definitionFit: Burgers and chips served quickly are food prepared for people in a hurry.

clue.text: Sketch popular and stable chap that is employed in entertaining guests

definitions.text: that is employed in entertaining guests

parts.note: to draw is to sketch
in means popular, fashionable
a groom looks after horses in a stable

explanation.surface: A stable lad who sketches is popular when guests come.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawing room is a formal reception room in a house for receiving visitors.

clue.text: In the form that was posted? Okay

parts.note: as means in the form of, in the manner of
sent means posted, dispatched by mail

explanation.surface: Someone approves a document exactly as it went through the post.
explanation.definitionFit: To give assent is to say yes, agreeing or approving something.

clue.text: Club, in first part of February, as it appears in table

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a golf club with a metal head

definitions.text: first part of February, as it appears in table
definitions.meaning: second meaning: FE, the opening two letters of February, is the element's symbol in the periodic table

explanation.walkthrough: The 'table' is the periodic table of chemical elements, where Fe stands for this metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A golf iron is a metal-headed club, and Fe is the chemical symbol of that metal.

clue.text: Note artist at home repeatedly showing loss of intellectual capacity

parts.note: B is a musical note
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
in means at home
the note, artist, at home sequence is given again, this time with D as the note

explanation.surface: A painter at home keeps playing a single note, suggesting their mind is going.
explanation.walkthrough: The sequence of note + artist + at home is used twice, with notes B and then D.
explanation.definitionFit: A brain drain is the emigration of skilled and educated people, a nation's loss of talent.

clue.text: Was the genius controlling teacher resented?

parts.note: a schoolmaster, a teacher, is a master
to mind something is to object to it, so minded means resented

explanation.surface: A question whether a clever schoolmaster was bitter about something.
explanation.definitionFit: To mastermind a plan is to be the brains directing it.

clue.text: Form of government in which ministers are all-powerful?

definitions.text: Form of government in which ministers are all-powerful?

parts.words: Form of government in which ministers are all-powerful?
parts.note: ministers suggests cabinet members, but here they are ministers of religion

explanation.walkthrough: 'ministers' reads as government ministers; the question mark hints at clergy.
explanation.definitionFit: This is rule by priests or religious authority claiming divine sanction.

clue.text: It divides two countries, or four, or six

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a border between nations
second meaning: in cricket a ... is a hit scoring four or six runs

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a ball reaching the field's edge scores four, or six if it gets there without bouncing.
explanation.definitionFit: A frontier line between states, and a cricket hit to the rope.

clue.text: Urge to cut back share? That's an overstatement

indicators.note: the urge and the cut, taken together, are read backwards

parts.note: to egg someone on is to urge them
to axe is to cut
a ration is a share or allowance

explanation.surface: Talk of cutting back a portion is dismissed as overstated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to cut' is a verb phrase standing for a single verb, and 'back' turns both the urge and the cutting word together, not just the second.
explanation.definitionFit: Exaggeration is representing something as bigger than it is, a form of overstating.

clue.text: Piece of music left in plane where it lands

definitions.note: a noun phrase: the place an aircraft lands

parts.note: an air is a tune
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: A tune plays on an aircraft as it comes in to land.
explanation.definitionFit: Aircraft touch down at an aerodrome with terminals and runways.

clue.text: Remainder when divided by five, namely? It's not settled

parts.note: the rest is the remainder

indicators.note: the namely abbreviation is split apart by the numeral placed in its middle

parts.note: i.e. means namely
V is the Roman numeral five

explanation.surface: An arithmetic remainder after division by five is described as unstable.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as maths; 'divided by' means one piece is split by the other.
explanation.definitionFit: Restive means fidgety or restless, unable to settle.

clue.text: Churchman impertinently questions Tory leader

parts.note: to pry is to enquire nosily

indicators.note: the leader of the word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A cleric rudely interrogates the head of the Conservatives.
explanation.definitionFit: A priest is an ordained minister of the church, a clergyman.

clue.text: Not yet decayed? It's uncertain

parts.note: pre- means before, not yet
carious means decayed, used of teeth or bone

explanation.surface: Something not yet rotten remains in doubt.
explanation.walkthrough: Carious is the dentist's word for decayed teeth.
explanation.definitionFit: Something precarious is insecure, its future doubtful and liable to fall.

clue.text: Flower cut with wavy edge

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the garden plant of the dianthus family
second meaning: to ... cloth is to cut it with a zigzag edge, as with ... shears

explanation.walkthrough: Pinking shears cut fabric with a serrated edge to stop fraying.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun names a carnation-like bloom; the verb describes trimming fabric in a zigzag.

clue.text: Hard question or subject for artist

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a puzzle or difficult problem
second meaning: someone who poses, a model sitting for a painter

explanation.walkthrough: Two separate senses of the same word joined by 'or'.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a tricky problem and also a sitter who models for painters.

clue.text: Cricket side at Oval smoothly added to score

definitions.note: the definition is an adverb with a note on where it appears: a direction written on a musical score

parts.note: the leg side is one half of a cricket field
O has an oval shape

explanation.surface: A cricket team plays at the Oval and adds runs to its score without fuss.
explanation.walkthrough: The Oval is a London cricket ground, which makes 'score' look like runs; it is a musical score.
explanation.definitionFit: Legato is the Italian performance direction telling musicians to play notes in a connected, flowing way.

clue.text: Principal support given old woman during visit

parts.note: ma is mother, informally an old woman
in means during
a stay is a visit

explanation.surface: An elderly mother provides the main help during a stay.
explanation.definitionFit: A mainstay is the chief prop, originally the stay securing a ship's mainmast.

clue.text: Meetings tax the patience of the best of people

parts.note: to try someone is to tax their patience
saints, abbreviated STS, are the best of people

explanation.surface: Meetings can wear down even very good people.
explanation.definitionFit: Trysts are secret romantic appointments, a lovers' rendezvous.

clue.text: Diamonds cut ahead of time, at great cost

parts.note: diamonds shortened to D, the card-suit abbreviation
early means ahead of time

explanation.surface: Gems cut prematurely, at great expense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' looks like gem cutting but just shortens diamonds to its letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying dearly means paying a high price, often figuratively.
